assumptions: Tỷ VND, nghìn units và nghìn machine-hours. Nhà máy giả lập Nắng Thiếc. Toy tối đa contribution trong kỳ, capacity chia được liên tục; chỉ các quyết định dưới đây khả thi. Đơn giá contribution triệu VND/unit; không tax.

evidence.text: [Order book] Product A price .8, variable cost .5, hours/unit 2, demand cap 40k units. Product B price 1.0, variable cost .6, hours/unit 4, demand cap 30k. Existing fixed cost 8 tỷ không đổi.
[Capacity] Bottleneck available 120k hours. At least 10k B units required by binding customer contract. A has no minimum. No outsourcing in base.
[Overtime] Additional 20k hours can be purchased as single block for 2.2 tỷ incremental cash expense. No changes to unit variable cost or demand.

[Alternative] Outsource 5k B units at purchase cost .75 triệu/unit, sell at 1.0; frees internal production required for B minimum if chosen. No minimum outsourcing except block 5k. Cannot combine outsourcing and overtime.
[Commercial] Demand caps apply to total own production + outsourced. No inventory carryover, penalties or other capacity use.
[Decision memo] Manager ranks B first by per-unit contribution; another analyst treats 8 fixed cost as avoidable if overtime rejected.

qas.question: Tính contribution per bottleneck hour của A, dùng đơn vị triệu VND/hour.
Base optimal plan dưới minimum B và capacity: contribution trước fixed cost?
qas.answer: B 10k dùng 40k hours, A 40k dùng 80k hours; contribution=10×.4+40×.3=16 tỷ.

qas.question: Overtime block cho phép thêm B bao nhiêu và net incremental contribution?
qas.answer: A đã cap, thêm 5k B cho 2 tỷ contribution, trừ 2,2 overtime thành −.2 tỷ.

qas.question: Nếu outsource block 5k B để đáp ứng minimum, optimal contribution tổng?
qas.answer: Internal 5k B +40k A dùng 100k hours; 20k free cho thêm 5k B. Tổng own B 10k, outsource 5k, A40k. Contribution=16+5×.25=17,25 tỷ.

qas.question: Operating profit tốt nhất trong ba phương án?
Tại sao xếp B trước vì contribution/unit cao hơn có thể làm giảm profit?
qas.answer: B dùng 4 hours mỗi unit, A 2. Resource scarce là giờ máy; phải xét contribution/hour cùng demand caps/minimum.

qas.question: Có coi fixed 8 là saving riêng cho phương án không overtime?
qas.answer: Không. Existing fixed cost chung không đổi; so incremental overtime hoặc outsourcing contribution.

qas.question: Có kết luận nên chấm dứt hợp đồng B dài hạn chỉ vì bottleneck?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu contract penalties, future demand, strategic value và capacity plan.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Chuỗi giả lập Mưa Rêu quyết định renew cửa hàng hoặc close và chuyển khách online. Toy so sánh one-year incremental cash contribution, fixed central costs unavoidable, exclude tax/discount.

evidence.text: [Renewal base] Store revenue forecast 150, merchandise variable cost 60% revenue, labor/utility cash 32, lease renewal rent 20. Central allocation 12 unavoidable regardless option.
[Closure alternative] 50% store revenue migrates to online, online merchandise cost 60%, incremental fulfillment 10% migrated sales. Other migrated sales none. Avoid all store labor/rent.
[Closure payments] One-time exit payment 6, inventory transfer cost 2, no severance beyond 6. No additional online fixed investment.
[Capacity] Online channel can absorb migrated sales at stated cost without impacting other online revenue.
[Uncertainty] Migration rate may be 30% or 70%; no probabilities. All other economics constant; existing common allocation 12 same.
[Memo] CFO compares store accounting profit after central allocation with online contribution before central and counts 150 as loss of group sales.

qas.question: Store renewal contribution before unavoidable central cost?
Base close contribution after migrated sales, fulfillment and exit/transfer?
Incremental one-year benefit của close so renew?
Migration rate hòa điểm để close ngang renew?
Nếu migration chỉ 30%, lợi ích close so renew?
qas.answer: Close=150×.3×.3−8=5,5; delta=−2,5 tỷ; renew tốt hơn.

qas.question: Tại sao không coi 12 allocation là avoidable saving khi close?
qas.answer: Central cost tồn tại trong cả hai phương án; chỉ avoidable store costs thay đổi quyết định.

qas.question: Có thể nói group revenue giảm toàn bộ 150 khi close?
qas.answer: Không. Base có 75 migrate sang online; group revenue giảm net 75 nếu không thay đổi khác.

qas.question: Có tính expected NPV của close cho 5 năm?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu migration probabilities, multi-year cash flows, lease terms và discount rate.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Ngân hàng giả lập Chồi Mai. Toy one-year loan expected risk-adjusted pretax profit = interest+fees−funding−operating−expected loss; capital allocated separately. Hurdle 15% pretax return on allocated capital, no tax.

evidence.text: [Proposal] Loan balance 500 constant, coupon 9%, annual fee 3 tỷ. Funding cost 5% balance; direct servicing 4 tỷ.
[Risk] Expected loss = EAD500×PD3%×LGD40%. Capital allocated 12% of exposure. No other income/costs.
[Stress] PD increases to 6%, LGD 50%; capital allocation becomes 15% EAD; funding rate 6%. Loan coupon and fee unchanged.
[Pricing mandate] To reach hurdle, solve annual coupon with fixed 3 fee, servicing cost and scenario-specific risk/funding/capital. No demand response.
[Alternative] Borrower offers guarantee reducing stress LGD to 25%, bank pays annual guarantee premium 2 tỷ. Stress PD, capital and funding unchanged.
[Memo] RM compares loan coupon 9% with funding 5%, calls 4% spread sufficient; omits capital hurdle.

qas.question: Expected loss base theo EAD, PD, LGD?
Risk-adjusted base profit trước tax?
Base return on allocated capital?
Minimum coupon stress không guarantee để đạt hurdle?
Minimum coupon stress có guarantee và premium?
Vì sao guarantee có thể cải thiện pricing dù phải trả premium?
qas.answer: Stress ECL giảm từ 15 xuống 7,5, saving 7,5 lớn hơn premium 2; net expected benefit 5,5.

qas.question: Có thể kết luận loan 9% an toàn vì base RAROC cao?
qas.answer: Không. Stress result dưới hurdle; expected loss không loại tail risk, chưa có borrower assessment đầy đủ.

qas.question: Có tính probability of actual capital depletion?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ expected loss và allocated capital; không loss distribution/correlation.

assumptions: Triệu USD. Công ty giả lập Mành Cỏ. Toy một-year insurance portfolio with mutually exclusive scenarios, compare expected pretax underwriting result and maximum scenario loss. No discount/tax; coverage pays scenario loss above retention up to limit.

evidence.text: [Portfolio] Net earned premium before prospective treaty 150; nonclaim expense 35. Gross loss scenarios: ordinary 90 (prob .80), severe 180 (.15), catastrophe 350 (.05).
[Treaty X] Annual premium 18, covers excess above retention 120, cap 100. No reinstatement or commission.
[Treaty Y] Annual premium 30, covers excess above retention 100, cap 200. Can buy X or Y or neither; no stacking.
[Board rule] Must ensure worst specified underwriting loss does not exceed 100 (i.e. result≥−100), then maximize expected result among qualifying choices.
[Accounting] Treaties cover gross claims; recoveries and premium reduce net underwriting result, no balance or cash timing effects.
[Memo] Broker recommends X solely because cheaper premium; finance team uses expected claims to test tail constraint.

qas.question: Expected gross claim loss across three scenarios?
Expected underwriting result without new treaty?
Expected X recoveries across scenarios?
qas.answer: Ordinary 0; severe 60; catastrophe capped100. Weighted 60×.15+100×.05=14 triệu USD.

qas.question: Worst underwriting result under X?
Worst result under Y and constraint status?
Expected result of Y, with severe recovery80 and catastrophe200?
Chọn phương án nào theo board rule dù expected result thấp hơn?
qas.answer: Y. Neither worst −235, X −153 đều vi phạm; Y worst −65 đạt. Rule ưu tiên tail constraint trước expected result.

qas.question: Có thể khẳng định maximum actual loss ngoài ba scenario cũng chỉ −65?
qas.answer: Không. Đây là worst trong scenario set, không bound toàn bộ loss distribution hoặc exclusions.

assumptions: Triệu USD, million compute units. Toy compare one-year spend, reserved block paid regardless use, excess billed on-demand. No credit rollover, performance identical.

evidence.text: [Workload] Base annual usage 100m compute units. Low scenario 60m with probability .25, base 100m .5, high 160m .25. Same service quality.
[Plan O] Pure on-demand $.12/unit, no fixed fee.
[Plan R] Reserve 100m units at $.085/unit upfront, pay excess over block $.13/unit. Unused capacity nonrefundable.
[Plan H] Reserve 60m units at $.09/unit upfront, excess $.12/unit. No other charge.
[Liquidity] Maximum upfront cash commitment 6m. Pay-as-used costs funded by operating cash later; no other constraints.
[Memo] CTO uses base usage only and chooses cheapest nominal rate, calls unused reservation a year-end asset.

qas.question: Expected annual compute units across scenarios?
Expected cost pure on-demand O?
Expected cost Plan R including high excess?
Expected cost Plan H with base/high excess?
Best feasible plan expected saving against O?
qas.answer: R upfront8,5>6, H upfront5,4 qualifies; H saves 12,6−10,8=1,8 triệu USD.

qas.question: Ở low scenario, reservation R có cheaper hơn O không?
qas.answer: Không. R trả 8,5 dù dùng60, O chỉ 7,2; expected saving không đảm bảo mọi scenario.

qas.question: Có ghi unused units R tại year-end thành asset nếu hợp đồng expire?
qas.answer: Không. No rollover/refund, quyền sử dụng đã hết; cost không tạo future entitlement.

qas.question: Có dự báo exact compute cost next year với workload mới?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu future usage distribution, price và contract renewal.

assumptions: Triệu USD quy đổi, thousand MWh. Toy one charge/discharge cycle per day, storage capacity measured input, round-trip efficiency 80%; charge buy at low price, sell actual discharged MWh high. No other degradation than variable cost.

evidence.text: [Battery] Maximum charge input 100 MWh/day, round-trip efficiency .8, 300 operating days. No carryover between days.
[Market] Offpeak price $40/MWh input; peak sale $100/MWh output. Variable degradation cost $10 per discharged MWh.
[Fixed] Annual fixed O&M .45m. No capex/financing in dispatch comparison. No alternative income.
[Alternative] Reserve 40% input capacity for ancillary service all days; fee .9m/year, remaining 60 MWh/day for arbitrage. No energy used by reserved capacity, no extra cost.
[Stress] Peak price falls to $70/MWh, offpeak and fee unchanged. Both plans use full available dispatch capacity. No probabilities.
[Memo] Operator multiplies input MWh by peak price without efficiency; calls fee incremental while retaining full arbitrage.

qas.question: Annual output delivered in all-arbitrage plan?
All-arbitrage annual contribution before fixed O&M?
Annual result with 40% reserved capacity in base?
All-arbitrage annual result under $70 peak stress?
Reserved plan annual result under stress?
Tại sao không cộng .9 fee vào all-arbitrage margin .96?
qas.answer: 40% capacity phải dành riêng, nên mất 40% arbitrage contribution; không thể bán cùng capacity hai lần.

qas.question: Peak price hòa điểm của arbitrage contribution trước fixed per MWh output?
qas.answer: Input cost/output=40/.8=50; degradation10; hòa điểm $60/MWh output. Fixed O&M khác.

qas.question: Có tính project payback để đầu tư battery mới?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu initial investment, replacement life và future cash flows.

assumptions: Triệu USD. Chủ tòa nhà giả lập Ban Công Đỏ. Toy 5-year retrofit decision at 8% discount, annual cash flows year-end, use supplied annuity factor 3.992710. Tax ignored; no terminal value unless given.

evidence.text: [Existing] Annual building energy cost 4m, tenants reimburse 75% through operating expense pass-through; owner bears 25%. Rent otherwise unchanged.
[Retrofit] Upfront capex 3m now; reduces annual energy cost by 40%, adds annual maintenance .15m. Pass-through percentage stays 75%, maintenance owner bears fully.
[Lease incentive] If retrofit certified, signed lease amendment raises annual rent .5m for five years, certain under toy. No vacancy change.
[Funding] Subsidy .6m approved and received now only if retrofit; no other financing. Net initial cash cost 2.4m.
[Valuation] Five-year annuity factor 3.992710; no salvage. No other effects.
[Memo] Engineer claims annual owner savings 1.6m and calculates payback on gross energy saving, ignores tenants' reimbursements.

qas.question: Annual gross building energy cost saving?
Owner retained saving after tenants' pass-through?
Net incremental annual cash flow including rent and maintenance?
NPV retrofit with subsidy and supplied annuity factor?
NPV nếu rent increase không xảy ra?
Vì sao gross saving không phải owner economic saving?
qas.answer: Tenant reimbursements giảm 75% saving, owner chỉ giữ phần energy cost tự chịu; cần thêm rent incentive.

qas.question: Có cộng subsidy .6 mỗi năm vào annual cash flows?
qas.answer: Không. Subsidy one-time lúc t0, giảm initial net outlay.

qas.question: Có dự báo giá trị property tăng theo cap rate?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu market cap rate và long-term NOI sau năm 5.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Nhà thầu giả lập Khe Núi. Toy sealed bid fixed price; expected cost includes mutually exclusive ground risk and independent bonus expected value. Board requires expected margin on bid price≥10% and worst specified loss≤20. No tax.

evidence.text: [Base budget] Direct labor/material 400, site overhead 40, bid preparation sunk 5 (already paid regardless bidding). No other avoidable cost.
[Ground risk] Normal prob .7 extra0, difficult .2 extra40, severe .1 extra120. All risk costs incremental; no price escalation reimbursement.
[Completion bonus] Independent probability .6 receive bonus 20 if early completion. Worst case no bonus. Bonus excluded from bid price denominator.
[Bid options] Offer price 500 or 540. Win probability .65 at500, .35 at540. If no win, no project cost or bonus; sunk preparation 5 same.
[Policy] Expected project profit conditional win=price+expected bonus−expected cost. Expected margin divides by base offer price. Worst loss must be ≤20 under severe/no bonus.
[Memo] Sales maximizes win probability and includes sunk preparation in comparing price offers; claims expected positive profit ensures worst risk passes.

qas.question: Expected incremental ground risk cost?
Expected total cost conditional win excluding sunk bid prep?
Expected margin conditional win for offer500?
Worst loss at price500 with severe and no bonus?
Worst loss at offer540?
Expected incremental bid profit of feasible 540 option accounting for win probability?
qas.answer: Conditional profit=92; .35×92=32,2 tỷ. Sunk cost not incremental.

qas.question: Nếu 500 expected unconditional profit 33,8 cao hơn 32,2, có chọn 500 không?
qas.answer: Không theo rule. 500 violates worst loss; 540 đạt margin và tail constraint. Expected win-adjusted profit không thay constraint.

qas.question: Có tối ưu continuous bid price giữa 500 và540?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ hai offers và hai win probabilities, không có win probability curve.
